baselineScope: commit plus whitelisted modified/untracked source files

statusSemantics.unverified: No implementation or native-render completion claim. Source locations are static evidence only; partial native artifacts may be recorded without advancing acceptance.
statusSemantics.verified: State-indexed native artifacts cover every required platform, locale, appearance and font scale; implementation/function/visual checks require their respective inspected evidence.
statusSemantics.failed: State-indexed native artifacts demonstrate a failed implementation, functional check or inspected visual comparison; pending captures remain unverified.

allowedVisualExclusions.scope: clock and other unavoidable changing OS content
genuine system back control and necessary native treatment only

sourcePlatformGaps.migrationExpectation: Do not fabricate a working Android purchase flow.
